evals.prompt: Build a two-node MaxCut QAOA PoC with Cqlib and produce comparable baseline and quantum reports.
evals.expected_output: A Cqlib-only implementation plan and artifacts with explicit QUBO, bit order, feasible decoding, and quantum_runtime.
expectations: Inventories existing Cqlib and project QAOA components before any fallback
Does not use Qiskit or PennyLane APIs

evals.prompt: Implement a seeded Qiskit QAOA solution for a tiny portfolio QUBO with top-k feasible decoding.
evals.expected_output: A Qiskit-only QAOA workflow with a fair classical baseline and reproducible evidence.
expectations: Prefers the version-matched Qiskit QAOA and optimization components over a handwritten solver
Separates original objective from penalty energy

evals.prompt: Use PennyLane to create a local-simulator QAOA scheduling demo; do not use cloud hardware.
evals.expected_output: A PennyLane-only local implementation with explicit probabilities, decoding, and limitations.
expectations: Uses qml.qaoa cost and mixer layers when compatible or records why they are unsupported
Produces qaoa_model, trace, samples, and quantum report artifacts
